name: Number field
description: A native number input between minus and plus buttons, for small counts: quantities, guests, seats. Typing, arrow keys, min, max and step work as for any number input.

classes.ayy-number-field: The bordered box around the buttons and the input. Draws the focus ring while you type.
classes.ayy-number-field--sm: Small height, for a cart line or a table cell.
classes.ayy-number-field__input: The <input type="number">: centred tabular digits, no spinner arrows.
classes.ayy-number-field__decrement: The minus <button> before the input. Needs an aria-label. aria-disabled="true" at min.
classes.ayy-number-field__increment: The plus <button> after the input. Needs an aria-label. aria-disabled="true" at max.

default.looks: One box like an Input (wash fill, line-strong border): minus, the number centred in tabular figures, plus.

hover.looks: Box border turns line-hover; a step button gets a wash-hover fill and text colour.

pressed.none: Step buttons have no pressed look; each press steps once.

focus.looks: Typing: the ring replaces the box border (as Input). A focused step button gets a 2px ring inset by 2px.

disabled.when: step button [aria-disabled="true"] at min or max; disabled on the input
disabled.looks: A step button that can't go further dims and ignores clicks but keeps focus. A disabled input dims the whole field.

scale.sm: Control sm height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch); the number is 2.75rem wide.
scale.md: Control md height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch); the number is 3.5rem wide.

sizes.density: Height, step-button width and text follow data-density.
sizes.width: Hugs its content (step buttons plus the number box).

js: numberFieldClass({ size?, className? }) → string; part class constants; numberFieldMinusIcon, numberFieldPlusIcon (SVG markup); stepNumberField(button) steps the input (stepUp/stepDown), fires input and change, and returns the new value; syncNumberField(field) sets the buttons' aria-disabled from min and max. @danitesler/ayywi/elements runs both for every .ayy-number-field on the page.

props.decrementLabel: string, default "Decrease" — say what changes ("Remove a guest")
props.className: On the outer box; every other prop goes to the input (id, name, aria-label…)

a11y: Label the input (a <label for> its id, or aria-label naming the item: "Quantity of Ethiopia Guji, 250 g"). The buttons need their own aria-labels.
At min or max the button gets aria-disabled instead of disabled, so focus stays on it while you click.
The input is a real number field: type a value, or use the arrow keys.
do: Use a number field for small whole counts people adjust by one or two: items in a cart, guests, seats, nights.
Set min and max (min 1 for guests, 0 when zero removes the line) and say the limit in a hint.
Use size sm in a cart line or a table row.
dont: Don't use it for large or exact numbers (a price, a phone number, a year) — use an Input; for a rough amount use a Slider.
Don't use it for a choice between a few named sizes — use a Segmented control or compact Choice cards.
